protocol.selection_rule: maximize cross-universe gate count, then maximize worst-universe prelock score
universes: fixed 2021 historical snapshot including later-delisted assets
protocol.costs: 13bps base, 40bps stress, 75bps extreme stress per turnover unit
protocol.anti_overfit: small pre-registered literature-inspired family; causal thresholds; no postlock tuning; worst-universe selection.
protocol.postlock_status: 2026-04-25+ has already been viewed in prior research and is diagnostic only, not pristine OOS.
protocol.fresh_forward: Only the paper tracker beginning 2026-09-08 is pristine forward evidence.

public_research_inspiration: cross-sectional dispersion as a momentum breakdown variable
limitations: Historical snapshot is fixed rather than fully dynamic point-in-time membership.
Daily bars omit intraday spread, market impact, outages and liquidation path.
The reused postlock cannot become untouched again; fresh proof must come from forward paper data.
